name: enermesh
description: EnerMesh: A Blockchain-Based Peer-to-Peer Renewable Energy Marketplace with Intelligent Matching, Dynamic Price Discovery, and Transparent Settlement

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w packages/contracts
